segments.name: K-12
segments.description: Provides U.S. schools with core, supplemental and intervention curricula in blended digital and print form, sold directly to districts.
segments.evidence: We are a top two provider in the K-12 market in the United States, serving approximately 91% of public K-12 districts.

segments.name: Higher Education
segments.description: Sells adaptive digital learning solutions, content and instructional materials to students, instructors and institutions at colleges and universities.
segments.evidence: We are a top two provider of digital and print learning solutions in the U.S. higher education market based on market share, serving approximately 81% of U.S. higher education institutions.

segments.name: Global Professional
segments.description: Provides medical and engineering learning solutions to students, institutions and professionals, largely through subscription-based access to trusted content.
segments.evidence: We are a global content provider of trusted, high-stakes medical and engineering learning solutions and support learners and educational institutions with technologies developed to maximize learning outcomes.

segments.name: International
segments.description: Sells digital and print solutions adapted from U.S. offerings to learners and educators outside the United States.
segments.evidence: We are a provider of comprehensive digital and print solutions in more than 100 countries and 80 languages outside the United States.

revenueModel.text: School districts, colleges and universities, medical and engineering institutions and professionals pay for digital and print learning solutions and subscriptions.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our learning solutions directly to school districts across the United States through multi-year contracts, providing strong visibility and predictability of forward revenue.
